description: Switch X-Lock for a company, company admins and owners only. With X-Lock on, every block, option or booking placed on one partner calendar (MMK or Nausys) also places a hold on the boat's other partner calendar. `sync_existing` true also places or releases those holds for the bookings and blocks already there. Returns the company as it now stands. Read the current value with its read tool first; this call returns the value as it now stands.

company_id.description: Company id, from list_boats (`company_id`) or get_company.

name: set_cross_lock
